title: Verbier Festival Shenzhen Masterclasses
field: Classical music performance (piano, strings, chamber music)
about: The Verbier Festival Shenzhen Masterclasses run 9-18 February 2027 for pianists and string players aged 14 to 26 and pre-formed chamber ensembles living or studying in the Asia-Pacific region. Applications close 30 November 2026 at 23:59 China Standard Time.
requirements: Pianists and string players aged 14 to 26 on 9 February 2027
Pre-formed trios and quartets with average age 18 to 28 on 9 February 2027; one ensemble selected
Must live or study in the Asia-Pacific region
